newsitem.title: GREECE: U.S. EMBASSY CLOSED ON MARTIN LUTHER KING'S BIRTHDAY, JAN 20.
newsitem.headline: U.S. EMBASSY CLOSED ON MARTIN LUTHER KING'S BIRTHDAY, JAN 20.

text.p: The U.S. embassy in Athens, the U.S. consulates general in Athens and Thessaloniki and all U.S. offices except for the American library will be closed on Monday in observance of Martin Luther King's birthday, the embassy said in a statement.
Martin Luther King's birthday is an official U.S. holiday. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
